purpose: Test whether Funding V2 adds practical asset-interpretation value without turning Funding into a new Money Core or running a broad research search.
return_definition: forward log total return from exact-ticker Yahoo monthly adjusted close, starting one month after the Funding observation month
per_relation_direction_pass: train Pearson > 0 AND OOS Pearson > 0 AND OOS Spearman > 0
gate: Both preselected DBC 6M and DBC 12M relations must pass direction. Secondary asset diagnostics are reported but cannot rescue or fail the gate.
interpretation: A PASS is evidence that the Funding overlay is directionally useful for the project’s pre-identified commodity/funding transmission channel. It is not a universal forecasting claim and does not by itself authorize promotion.
promotion_after_pass: If the gate passes, archive the result and proceed to a production-readiness review: reproducibility/provenance, scheduled refresh, Data Health integration and explicit overlay promotion. Money Core remains untouched.
failure_rule: If either primary relation fails, report the failure and do not retune Candidate 2 or search for a replacement horizon in this gate.
